cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(pcm_dsd_converter VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES C)
option(PCM_DSD_USE_MKL "Use Intel oneMKL FFT (OFF selects the portable FFT)" ON)
if(PCM_DSD_USE_MKL)
  set(MKL_LINK static)
  set(MKL_THREADING sequential)
  set(MKL_INTERFACE lp64)
  find_package(MKL CONFIG REQUIRED HINTS
    "$ENV{MKLROOT}/lib/cmake/mkl"
    "C:/Program Files (x86)/Intel/oneAPI/mkl/latest/lib/cmake/mkl")
endif()
function(pcm_dsd_fft_backend target)
  if(PCM_DSD_USE_MKL)
    target_compile_definitions(${target} PRIVATE PCM_DSD_USE_MKL)
    target_link_libraries(${target} PRIVATE MKL::MKL)
  endif()
endfunction()
add_library(pcm_dsd_converter SHARED src/pcm_dsd_converter.c)
pcm_dsd_fft_backend(pcm_dsd_converter)
target_compile_definitions(pcm_dsd_converter PRIVATE PCM_DSD_BUILD)
target_include_directories(pcm_dsd_converter PUBLIC include)
set_target_properties(pcm_dsd_converter PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED YES)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_converter PRIVATE /W4 /fp:strict)
  set_property(TARGET pcm_dsd_converter PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
else()
  target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_converter PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
  target_link_libraries(pcm_dsd_converter PRIVATE m)
endif()
option(PCM_DSD_BUILD_TESTS "Build converter tests" ON)
if(PCM_DSD_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(pcm_dsd_benchmark tests/benchmark.c)
  target_include_directories(pcm_dsd_benchmark PRIVATE include)
  pcm_dsd_fft_backend(pcm_dsd_benchmark)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_benchmark PRIVATE /fp:strict)
  else()
    target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_benchmark PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
    target_link_libraries(pcm_dsd_benchmark PRIVATE m)
  endif()
  add_executable(pcm_dsd_test tests/test_converter.c)
  target_link_libraries(pcm_dsd_test PRIVATE pcm_dsd_converter)
  add_test(NAME pcm_dsd_stream COMMAND pcm_dsd_test)
  add_executable(pcm_dsd_dsp_test tests/test_dsp.c)
  pcm_dsd_fft_backend(pcm_dsd_dsp_test)
  target_include_directories(pcm_dsd_dsp_test PRIVATE include)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_dsp_test PRIVATE /W4 /fp:strict)
  else()
    target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_dsp_test PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
    target_link_libraries(pcm_dsd_dsp_test PRIVATE m)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME pcm_dsd_numerics COMMAND pcm_dsd_dsp_test)
  add_executable(pcm_dsd_options_test tests/test_options.c)
  pcm_dsd_fft_backend(pcm_dsd_options_test)
  target_include_directories(pcm_dsd_options_test PRIVATE include)
  if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_options_test PRIVATE /W4 /fp:strict)
  else()
    target_compile_options(pcm_dsd_options_test PRIVATE -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math)
    target_link_libraries(pcm_dsd_options_test PRIVATE m)
  endif()
  add_test(NAME pcm_dsd_options COMMAND pcm_dsd_options_test)
endif()
install(TARGETS pcm_dsd_converter RUNTIME DESTINATION bin ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES include/pcm_dsd_converter.h DESTINATION include)
install(FILES LICENSE README.md DESTINATION .)
if(PCM_DSD_USE_MKL)
  install(DIRECTORY licenses/onemkl DESTINATION licenses)
endif()
